title: DRISHTIKON: A Multimodal Multilingual Benchmark for Testing Language Models’ Understanding on Indian Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models using a multimodal multiple-choice question benchmark (DRISHTIKON) covering fine-grained Indian cultural themes like festivals, attire, cuisine, and art, to measure cultural competence and highlight Western or majority-culture alignment.

Translating the multimodal benchmark into 14 Indian languages and comparing model accuracy across them to expose performance disparities between high-resource languages (e.g., English, Hindi) and low-resource languages (e.g., Sindhi, Konkani).

Analyzing model accuracy metrics geographically across all 28 Indian states and 8 union territories to reveal representational gaps and uneven learning for smaller or less-represented regions (e.g., Lakshadweep, Mizoram).
